description:
Run a tool saved on a computer (see computer_tools), with arguments.

GOOD TO KNOW: tools work on files on the computer. To use a Library file, copy it in first (computer_copy_in); to give the person a result, copy it out afterwards (computer_copy_out).

If the command is still running after about 45 seconds, the result has state "running" and a job id: call computer_job with that job to keep waiting (each call waits up to 45 s more and returns new output from next_offset). A running job is ended automatically if nobody waits on it for 3 minutes, so keep calling computer_job while you still want it; when the person stops your turn, it ends too.

RETURNS: the same shape as computer_run.

computer.description: The computer's name, as computer_list shows it (for example "research").

timeout_sec.description: End it after this many seconds. Default 1800.

name: computer_use_tool
